'''Gliese''' is an NPC in {{Location|Error Cell}}.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Gliese}}
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Gliese:''' Me? I'm picking a [[Tethys_System#Stellar_Matrix|Stellar Matrix]] for the new recruits' training session, as the basis of projection.
:{{DIcon}} Projection?
:'''Gliese:''' Yes, it's what we do with the Infinite Reality Sandbox here are the [[Black Shores]]. It projects data from the Stellar Matrix into reality.
:'''Gliese:''' Using digital samples of the Tacet Discords, the [[Tethys System]] can analyze and predict their possible evolutionary models.
:'''Gliese:''' But some of the models that evolved from errors are just too out-there to show.
:'''Gliese:''' Can't have anything too hideous or messed up... It's challenging to choose a decent one...
{{Dialogue End}}
